predictions: And one week after my best week of the season, my picks come full-on crashing back to Earth. My worst week of the season, and almost one in which I got more wrong that right. 12-11. That is pretty pathetic. I don't even know what to say about that… it's just a poor performance, and it's becoming clear that I will never ever ever understand about five of this season's teams. In fact, I think they are giving rise to a trivia question for page 1 this week… yep, I'm going to make one.

Match of the week: (F Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Village Idiots. Both Ton 80 and the Idiots posted big wins and added a little more gap on the Sofa Kings. Ton 80 and Sofa have already played a second time, so only the Idiots still get shots at both competitors in this tight race. Bottom line is both teams pretty much control their own fates at this point. Ton 80 kinda rolled this one last time, but win close here, 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Double In, Uber Out @ Why So Serious? Oh, what might have been for Uber, with Serious taking one on the chin last week. But they took another one on the chin at the same time! Holy flippin' missed opportunities, Batman! Now with their point deficit, Uber has to win here AND gain another on Serious to reel in the B title. Uber loves when I pick against them, so here they go… Serious, 15-9.

Match #3: (D Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Cheap Shots. Off Constantly lost to the 6th place team last week, dropping them to 2-3 in the last five weeks. Gone is the D lead, gone is even any comfort that a top-two finish is coming. D has become about a six-team free-for-all, and the Rangers are the hottest team in the division! OC still, 14-10.

Match #4: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Double In Stumble Out. C division is somehow actually a tighter top-to-bottom race than D is. Every single match could go either way, and almost every team is likely to finish right around 0.500. The Niners absolutely pummeled Stumble Out last time they met, but I think Stumble pulls both teams to flat 4-4s here, 13-11.

Match #5: (B Div.) Iceman's Ear Defenders @ Blindsided. Blindsided is now only 1-3 against the other three top-half teams. Even though Iceman's is 0-5 against the top half, they've played a ton of close ones and are not to be overlooked. Blindsided escapes, but barely, 13-11.

Match #6: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Bangin The Wire. With the other two F leaders pairing off in the match of the week, the 2nd "winner" in that match could be these Sofa Kings. But to be there, they have to handle their own difficult Bangin business here. They do, 13-11.

Match #7: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ DD-214. This part of the D story told in match #3 features two 0.500 or better teams who likely still have very real title hopes. Been a rough stretch for DD (three scores 4-5 points in their last four), so I'll take Menace, 14-10.

Matches #8 & #9: (G Div.) We're Sexy/We Throw It @ Nein Mark; Rock Bottoms @ Ones Are Closed. Rippin is running away with the G crown, but second place (and a likely climb to F) is still up for grabs. With the Corks' big win last week, those Corks have kind of set up on of the second place mountain and yelled out "alright, who is coming to get us?" And now we get this awesome duo of what almost appear to be elimination matches in the chase group. Nein gets payback on Throw It, 14-10; and Ones top the Bottoms, 14-10.

Match #10: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Death Throw. The road to reel in the Ducks and Humpers is long and difficult. But only one team is even going to get to try that journey. And that team is the winner of this pairing right here. I like Machine, but… DT, 13-11.
Match #11: (D Div.) BullsHit @ Red-eye Rangers. Yep, this is a bottom-two matchup. Or… is this the Rangers' chance to hang a 4-match win streak on the end of their 0-5 start? Rangers it is! 14-10.
Match #12: (F Div.) Shoot-Da-Bull @ Neighborhood Dart Knights. A trio of 2-7 teams in F is likely to send two to G next season. Wins within the group are obviously key. Dart Knights get this, 13-11.
And the remaining 11 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: The Global Element 19, Darty Minds 5; The Bullies 19, Consis. Inconsistent 5; Liver Alliance 19, Armed & Hammered 5.
B Division: Matt's 14, Outlaws 10; Dart Attack 14, Boom Baby 10.
C Division: Show Me 16, McGavin 8; Trippin Bulls 14, Rif Raf 10.
E Division: Hump Day! 16, Irish Ton 8; Y.N.T.A. 15, She Said 9.
